decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable in the core thermoforming range that costs little to keep in the catalog, though the lack of website visibility since 2020 adds some uncertainty.
PETG blanks are a staple thermoforming material for dental labs and support steady consumable sales alongside the existing blank portfolio.
The UV-curing lacquer has always had low visibility, but it fits lab finishing workflows and is cheap to stock, so keeping it remains reasonable.
Custom earmolds are core custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers and fit the move toward digital production, so the line is more likely to be refined than dropped.
Custom hearing protection uses the same digital earmold production and serves a growing occupational and end-user segment, giving it good synergy with the earmold business.
